# entrepot_blob_store (Resource)

A blob store holds repository content. `file` stores use a directory on a mounted volume (PVC, EBS, EFS) under the server's `storage.allowedRoots`; `s3` stores use an S3-compatible bucket. Repositories choose their blob store at creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A directory on a mounted volume (PVC, EBS or EFS) under the server's storage.allowedRoots.
resource "entrepot_blob_store" "efs" {
  name = "shared"
  type = "file"
  file = { path = "/data/shared" }
}

# An S3 bucket. Leave access_key_id unset to use IRSA / the AWS default credential chain.
resource "entrepot_blob_store" "s3" {
  name = "artifacts"
  type = "s3"
  s3 = {
    bucket             = "my-entrepot-artifacts"
    region             = "eu-west-2"
    prefix             = "prod"
    redirect_downloads = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Blob store name. Changing it forces a new store.
- `type` (String) `file` or `s3`. Changing it forces a new store.

### Optional

- `file` (Attributes) Settings for `type = "file"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--file))
- `s3` (Attributes) Settings for `type = "s3"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--s3))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `name`.

<a id="nestedatt--file"></a>
### Nested Schema for `file`

Required:

- `path` (String) Directory, e.g. `/data/default`.


<a id="nestedatt--s3"></a>
### Nested Schema for `s3`

Required:

- `bucket` (String)

Optional:

- `access_key_id` (String) Leave unset to use the AWS default credential chain (IRSA).
- `endpoint` (String) Custom endpoint for MinIO, Ceph RGW, R2, …
- `force_path_style` (Boolean) Use path-style addressing (MinIO).
- `prefix` (String) Key prefix inside the bucket.
- `redirect_downloads` (Boolean) Redirect large downloads to presigned S3 URLs.
- `region` (String)
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Write-only: never returned by the API, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Blob stores are imported by name.
terraform import entrepot_blob_store.s3 artifacts
```
